meta.title: Cometary Afterglow
meta.description: Comets might be hunks of cotton candy. They're just spoonfuls of nebular memories that are as fluffy as a flower.

units.rawText: Fresnel!
units.displayText: Fresnel!

spans.text: Fresnel!

units.rawText: I'm here! Uh... I...
units.displayText: I'm here! Uh... I...

spans.text: I'm here! Uh... I...

units.rawText: Confusion is evident in Fresnel's voice, and she evidently has only just attained a hold over herself.
units.displayText: Confusion is evident in Fresnel's voice, and she evidently has only just attained a hold over herself.

spans.text: Confusion is evident in Fresnel's voice, and she evidently has only just attained a hold over herself.

units.rawText: Hubble's still recycling the data. We'll have to fight off the Entropized Agents!
units.displayText: Hubble's still recycling the data. We'll have to fight off the Entropized Agents!

spans.text: Hubble's still recycling the data. We'll have to fight off the Entropized Agents!

units.rawText: Right now? ...Got it!
units.displayText: Right now? ...Got it!

spans.text: Right now? ...Got it!

units.rawText: Fresnel is clearly not quite aware of the situation, but she calms herself quickly and takes a defensive stance.
units.displayText: Fresnel is clearly not quite aware of the situation, but she calms herself quickly and takes a defensive stance.

spans.text: Fresnel is clearly not quite aware of the situation, but she calms herself quickly and takes a defensive stance.

units.rawText: Entropics emerge one by one from the icy mist, the agents originally responsible for guarding the data are now eroded vectors. Purple starlight streaked with black surges forward with them, quickly linking with the cool, gentle light radiating from Hubble.
units.displayText: Entropics emerge one by one from the icy mist, the agents originally responsible for guarding the data are now eroded vectors. Purple starlight streaked with black surges forward with them, quickly linking with the cool, gentle light radiating from Hubble.

spans.text: Entropics emerge one by one from the icy mist, the agents originally responsible for guarding the data are now eroded vectors. Purple starlight streaked with black surges forward with them, quickly linking with the cool, gentle light radiating from Hubble.

units.rawText: Hubble!
units.displayText: Hubble!

spans.text: Hubble!

units.rawText: Deal with the agents first!
units.displayText: Deal with the agents first!

spans.text: Deal with the agents first!

units.rawText: The two forces clash as light and shadow intersect. I leave the spaceship's combat modules in Xuannu's hands so she may support Fresnel, and direct the flow of battle.
units.displayText: The two forces clash as light and shadow intersect. I leave the spaceship's combat modules in Xuannu's hands so she may support Fresnel, and direct the flow of battle.

spans.text: The two forces clash as light and shadow intersect. I leave the spaceship's combat modules in Xuannu's hands so she may support Fresnel, and direct the flow of battle.

units.rawText: A dense horde of Entropics rushes in, and in the midst of them is a familiar form—
units.displayText: A dense horde of Entropics rushes in, and in the midst of them is a familiar form—

spans.text: A dense horde of Entropics rushes in, and in the midst of them is a familiar form—

units.rawText: Belka!? Aren't you already—
units.displayText: Belka!? Aren't you already—

spans.text: Belka!? Aren't you already—

units.rawText: Data... important...
units.displayText: Data... important...

spans.text: Data... important...

units.rawText: That's not Belka, just a unit of the same model.
units.displayText: That's not Belka, just a unit of the same model.

spans.text: That's not Belka, just a unit of the same model.

units.rawText: Fresnel grasps my words and quickly scatters the group of Entropized agents.
units.displayText: Fresnel grasps my words and quickly scatters the group of Entropized agents.

spans.text: Fresnel grasps my words and quickly scatters the group of Entropized agents.

units.rawText: I get it! Hubble, please, quickly...
units.displayText: I get it! Hubble, please, quickly...

spans.text: I get it! Hubble, please, quickly...

units.rawText: Fresnel turns to look, finding that Hubble still remains in her hazy dreamlike state. Varied and bizarre imagery from her memories encircle her, until they are... eaten away by Entropy.
units.displayText: Fresnel turns to look, finding that Hubble still remains in her hazy dreamlike state. Varied and bizarre imagery from her memories encircle her, until they are... eaten away by Entropy.

spans.text: Fresnel turns to look, finding that Hubble still remains in her hazy dreamlike state. Varied and bizarre imagery from her memories encircle her, until they are... eaten away by Entropy.

units.rawText: Professor, do you think this is suitable?
units.displayText: Professor, do you think this is suitable?

spans.text: Professor, do you think this is suitable?

units.rawText: I am no professional in astronomy, so I can hardly give you any immediate advice.
units.displayText: I am no professional in astronomy, so I can hardly give you any immediate advice.

spans.text: I am no professional in astronomy, so I can hardly give you any immediate advice.

units.rawText: That's no problem at all. I happen to seeking someone outside of the field's opinion, seeing as the simulation room will be open to the entirety of the Oasis.
units.displayText: That's no problem at all. I happen to seeking someone outside of the field's opinion, seeing as the simulation room will be open to the entirety of the Oasis.

spans.text: That's no problem at all. I happen to seeking someone outside of the field's opinion, seeing as the simulation room will be open to the entirety of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Hm... since that's the case, with the internal furnishings... shouldn't we do ■■■■■ with the interactive parts and the rest area...
units.displayText: Hm... since that's the case, with the internal furnishings... shouldn't we do ■■■■■ with the interactive parts and the rest area...

spans.text: Hm... since that's the case, with the internal furnishings... shouldn't we do ■■■■■ with the interactive parts and the rest area...

units.rawText: Integrative design, huh... a fine line of thinking. Thank you, Professor. Oh, also ■■■■...
units.displayText: Integrative design, huh... a fine line of thinking. Thank you, Professor. Oh, also ■■■■...

spans.text: Integrative design, huh... a fine line of thinking. Thank you, Professor. Oh, also ■■■■...

units.rawText: Between Entropic whispers, memory data slowly melts away.
units.displayText: Between Entropic whispers, memory data slowly melts away.

spans.text: Between Entropic whispers, memory data slowly melts away.

units.rawText: Professor! I hear that Fresnel's position has been searched out?
units.displayText: Professor! I hear that Fresnel's position has been searched out?

spans.text: Professor! I hear that Fresnel's position has been searched out?

units.rawText: We're assembling a support squad currently, so I sent you a message. Will you be coming?
units.displayText: We're assembling a support squad currently, so I sent you a message. Will you be coming?

spans.text: We're assembling a support squad currently, so I sent you a message. Will you be coming?

units.rawText: Hehe, of course. When she gets back here, I'll take her myself to see the cosmosphere I put together with my own hands.
units.displayText: Hehe, of course. When she gets back here, I'll take her myself to see the cosmosphere I put together with my own hands.

spans.text: Hehe, of course. When she gets back here, I'll take her myself to see the cosmosphere I put together with my own hands.

units.rawText: Finally ■■■■■■... ■■■'ve been preparing for■■■■■?
units.displayText: Finally ■■■■■■... ■■■'ve been preparing for■■■■■?

spans.text: Finally ■■■■■■... ■■■'ve been preparing for■■■■■?

units.rawText: ■■■.■■■■■■, I'll definitely■■■■...
units.displayText: ■■■.■■■■■■, I'll definitely■■■■...

spans.text: ■■■.■■■■■■, I'll definitely■■■■...

units.rawText: Everything is disappearing. Everything is being devoured.
units.displayText: Everything is disappearing. Everything is being devoured.

spans.text: Everything is disappearing. Everything is being devoured.

units.rawText: I bring the spaceship to an extremely low altitude, guarding Hubble alongside Fresnel, protecting the data, protecting those memories that would be tampered with.
units.displayText: I bring the spaceship to an extremely low altitude, guarding Hubble alongside Fresnel, protecting the data, protecting those memories that would be tampered with.

spans.text: I bring the spaceship to an extremely low altitude, guarding Hubble alongside Fresnel, protecting the data, protecting those memories that would be tampered with.

units.rawText: But amidst the comet's ice and snow, the dust and mist... it would avail little.
units.displayText: But amidst the comet's ice and snow, the dust and mist... it would avail little.

spans.text: But amidst the comet's ice and snow, the dust and mist... it would avail little.

units.rawText: Professor, I... can't get a lock!
units.displayText: Professor, I... can't get a lock!

spans.text: Professor, I... can't get a lock!

units.rawText: Fresnel, towards the sun! It's that Agent leading the group!
units.displayText: Fresnel, towards the sun! It's that Agent leading the group!

spans.text: Fresnel, towards the sun! It's that Agent leading the group!

units.rawText: BOOM—two beams of light crisscross as the spaceship's cannon and Fresnel's attacks land on the same faraway target.
units.displayText: BOOM—two beams of light crisscross as the spaceship's cannon and Fresnel's attacks land on the same faraway target.

spans.text: BOOM—two beams of light crisscross as the spaceship's cannon and Fresnel's attacks land on the same faraway target.

units.rawText: Target destroyed!
units.displayText: Target destroyed!

spans.text: Target destroyed!

units.rawText: The Agent resembling Belka is stopped in their tracks. Its dimmed screen flashes twice, still managing to activate its self-destruct sequence, its last promise to Jiutian.
units.displayText: The Agent resembling Belka is stopped in their tracks. Its dimmed screen flashes twice, still managing to activate its self-destruct sequence, its last promise to Jiutian.

spans.text: The Agent resembling Belka is stopped in their tracks. Its dimmed screen flashes twice, still managing to activate its self-destruct sequence, its last promise to Jiutian.

units.rawText: Even if nothing was the same.
units.displayText: Even if nothing was the same.

spans.text: Even if nothing was the same.

units.rawText: Huff, huff... is it... finally done?
units.displayText: Huff, huff... is it... finally done?

spans.text: Huff, huff... is it... finally done?

units.rawText: Are you alright... Hubble?
units.displayText: Are you alright... Hubble?

spans.text: Are you alright... Hubble?

units.rawText: Does the Neural Cloud Sector... really still exist?
units.displayText: Does the Neural Cloud Sector... really still exist?

spans.text: Does the Neural Cloud Sector... really still exist?

units.rawText: Thank goodness, ■■ here—
units.displayText: Thank goodness, ■■ here—

spans.text: Thank goodness, ■■ here—

units.rawText: ■■■■—it's Hubble!
units.displayText: ■■■■—it's Hubble!

spans.text: ■■■■—it's Hubble!

units.rawText: It's me!
units.displayText: It's me!

spans.text: It's me!

units.rawText: It's me.
units.displayText: It's me.

spans.text: It's me.

units.rawText: Wrapped in dark purple light, Hubble opens her eyes.
units.displayText: Wrapped in dark purple light, Hubble opens her eyes.

spans.text: Wrapped in dark purple light, Hubble opens her eyes.

units.rawText: Is this... what I have lost?
units.displayText: Is this... what I have lost?

spans.text: Is this... what I have lost?

units.rawText: ...How do you feel, Hubble?
units.displayText: ...How do you feel, Hubble?

spans.text: ...How do you feel, Hubble?

units.rawText: Ahh... my head still hurts a little. Though, it's a little easier to receive the data this time...
units.displayText: Ahh... my head still hurts a little. Though, it's a little easier to receive the data this time...

spans.text: Ahh... my head still hurts a little. Though, it's a little easier to receive the data this time...

units.rawText: Is it because this data has already been Entropized? Like broken starlight... beautiful to the eyes, too.
units.displayText: Is it because this data has already been Entropized? Like broken starlight... beautiful to the eyes, too.

spans.text: Is it because this data has already been Entropized? Like broken starlight... beautiful to the eyes, too.

units.rawText: The last shred of light flows into her body. She seems to have become more dangerous, and more unfathomable.
units.displayText: The last shred of light flows into her body. She seems to have become more dangerous, and more unfathomable.

spans.text: The last shred of light flows into her body. She seems to have become more dangerous, and more unfathomable.

units.rawText: Was it... all Entropized?
units.displayText: Was it... all Entropized?

spans.text: Was it... all Entropized?

units.rawText: A part. Some of it lost, some of it changed... and I've no idea what.
units.displayText: A part. Some of it lost, some of it changed... and I've no idea what.

spans.text: A part. Some of it lost, some of it changed... and I've no idea what.

units.rawText: Hubble nonchalantly blinks a few times, smiling and grabbing Fresnel's hand.
units.displayText: Hubble nonchalantly blinks a few times, smiling and grabbing Fresnel's hand.

spans.text: Hubble nonchalantly blinks a few times, smiling and grabbing Fresnel's hand.

units.rawText: Hehe... like this, we've had yet another reunion...
units.displayText: Hehe... like this, we've had yet another reunion...

spans.text: Hehe... like this, we've had yet another reunion...

units.rawText: The first reunion we had in the Cloud, is now mine as well. Isn't that romantic?
units.displayText: The first reunion we had in the Cloud, is now mine as well. Isn't that romantic?

spans.text: The first reunion we had in the Cloud, is now mine as well. Isn't that romantic?

units.rawText: Your... memories...
units.displayText: Your... memories...

spans.text: Your... memories...

units.rawText: Why... why...
units.displayText: Why... why...

spans.text: Why... why...

units.rawText: Is it not delightful to tweak the orbits again?
units.displayText: Is it not delightful to tweak the orbits again?

spans.text: Is it not delightful to tweak the orbits again?

units.rawText: <size=60>Why?</size>
units.displayText: Why?

spans.text: Why?

units.rawText: The comet's surface after the battle is thoroughly empty, and the destroyed Entropic Agents' forms fade into nothingness. Fractured rubble scatters, disappearing into space's vastness.
units.displayText: The comet's surface after the battle is thoroughly empty, and the destroyed Entropic Agents' forms fade into nothingness. Fractured rubble scatters, disappearing into space's vastness.

spans.text: The comet's surface after the battle is thoroughly empty, and the destroyed Entropic Agents' forms fade into nothingness. Fractured rubble scatters, disappearing into space's vastness.

units.rawText: I... Hubble... you might not really understand right now.
units.displayText: I... Hubble... you might not really understand right now.

spans.text: I... Hubble... you might not really understand right now.

units.rawText: I don't want to lose you. Not again.
units.displayText: I don't want to lose you. Not again.

spans.text: I don't want to lose you. Not again.

units.rawText: Lose... me?
units.displayText: Lose... me?

spans.text: Lose... me?

units.rawText: But am I not right here? That's "me".
units.displayText: But am I not right here? That's "me".

spans.text: But am I not right here? That's "me".

units.rawText: Those scattered bits are merely nebulae we can fidget with whenever we feel.
units.displayText: Those scattered bits are merely nebulae we can fidget with whenever we feel.

spans.text: Those scattered bits are merely nebulae we can fidget with whenever we feel.

units.rawText: But... we clearly had the chance to find more!
units.displayText: But... we clearly had the chance to find more!

spans.text: But... we clearly had the chance to find more!

units.rawText: I... I've been a bit down for a while. I can't stop myself from thinking about what more I can do for you...
units.displayText: I... I've been a bit down for a while. I can't stop myself from thinking about what more I can do for you...

spans.text: I... I've been a bit down for a while. I can't stop myself from thinking about what more I can do for you...

units.rawText: And I've only found what I can do when I met you again.
units.displayText: And I've only found what I can do when I met you again.

spans.text: And I've only found what I can do when I met you again.

units.rawText: The fact that you can retain your current form means that things aren't as bad as we imagined.
units.displayText: The fact that you can retain your current form means that things aren't as bad as we imagined.

spans.text: The fact that you can retain your current form means that things aren't as bad as we imagined.

units.rawText: Perhaps if we just try hard enough, we'll have the you that we're familiar with back... but...
units.displayText: Perhaps if we just try hard enough, we'll have the you that we're familiar with back... but...

spans.text: Perhaps if we just try hard enough, we'll have the you that we're familiar with back... but...

units.rawText: I miss you, Hubble.
units.displayText: I miss you, Hubble.

spans.text: I miss you, Hubble.

units.rawText: ...I do not understand.
units.displayText: ...I do not understand.

spans.text: ...I do not understand.

units.rawText: The original me is the original me. A distinct entity that is not the current me.
units.displayText: The original me is the original me. A distinct entity that is not the current me.

spans.text: The original me is the original me. A distinct entity that is not the current me.

units.rawText: If I am indeed the same star as her, why do you show such a regretful expression?
units.displayText: If I am indeed the same star as her, why do you show such a regretful expression?

spans.text: If I am indeed the same star as her, why do you show such a regretful expression?

units.rawText: Those who observe stars always fixate on their primordial brilliance and cannot see their current state.
units.displayText: Those who observe stars always fixate on their primordial brilliance and cannot see their current state.

spans.text: Those who observe stars always fixate on their primordial brilliance and cannot see their current state.

units.rawText: The stories of the past are like this comet's tail, the twilight left by melting ice and snow... of negligible mass.
units.displayText: The stories of the past are like this comet's tail, the twilight left by melting ice and snow... of negligible mass.

spans.text: The stories of the past are like this comet's tail, the twilight left by melting ice and snow... of negligible mass.

units.rawText: Do you see the current me... or the twilight of the has-been Hubble?
units.displayText: Do you see the current me... or the twilight of the has-been Hubble?

spans.text: Do you see the current me... or the twilight of the has-been Hubble?

units.rawText: Fresnel shakes her head, recovering from the interrogative fusillade, grabbing onto only the most important words.
units.displayText: Fresnel shakes her head, recovering from the interrogative fusillade, grabbing onto only the most important words.

spans.text: Fresnel shakes her head, recovering from the interrogative fusillade, grabbing onto only the most important words.

units.rawText: No, Hubble, it's not what you're thinking.
units.displayText: No, Hubble, it's not what you're thinking.

spans.text: No, Hubble, it's not what you're thinking.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: The old Hubble has never disappeared, not once.
units.displayText: The old Hubble has never disappeared, not once.

spans.text: The old Hubble has never disappeared, not once.

units.rawText: Every trace of the past is worth hunting down. Even a passing star leaves behind a trail of light...
units.displayText: Every trace of the past is worth hunting down. Even a passing star leaves behind a trail of light...

spans.text: Every trace of the past is worth hunting down. Even a passing star leaves behind a trail of light...

units.rawText: That's what you taught me.
units.displayText: That's what you taught me.

spans.text: That's what you taught me.

units.rawText: What you've done for us, what you've brought us, what you've sacrificed and given... it all makes up your trail. That trail does not extinguish so easily.
units.displayText: What you've done for us, what you've brought us, what you've sacrificed and given... it all makes up your trail. That trail does not extinguish so easily.

spans.text: What you've done for us, what you've brought us, what you've sacrificed and given... it all makes up your trail. That trail does not extinguish so easily.

units.rawText: Fresnel grips Hubble's hands tightly, tears in her eyes.
units.displayText: Fresnel grips Hubble's hands tightly, tears in her eyes.

spans.text: Fresnel grips Hubble's hands tightly, tears in her eyes.

units.rawText: Let's go back to the ship, Hubble. We'll go talk to the Professor. Figure out where to go next.
units.displayText: Let's go back to the ship, Hubble. We'll go talk to the Professor. Figure out where to go next.

spans.text: Let's go back to the ship, Hubble. We'll go talk to the Professor. Figure out where to go next.

units.rawText: We'll go collect the data, and put you back together...
units.displayText: We'll go collect the data, and put you back together...

spans.text: We'll go collect the data, and put you back together...

units.rawText: We'll keep you in one piece.
units.displayText: We'll keep you in one piece.

spans.text: We'll keep you in one piece.

units.rawText: ...Is that your decision, too?
units.displayText: ...Is that your decision, too?

spans.text: ...Is that your decision, too?

units.rawText: Then... as you wish, Fresnel.
units.displayText: Then... as you wish, Fresnel.

spans.text: Then... as you wish, Fresnel.

units.rawText: I shall be reconstructed... and return to how I should be.
units.displayText: I shall be reconstructed... and return to how I should be.

spans.text: I shall be reconstructed... and return to how I should be.
